mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (name, volume, price, category_id, supplier_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{volume}, #{price}, #{categoryId}, #{supplierId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM products WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND category_id = #{categoryId}
SELECT spirit_id AS id, name, price, category_id AS categoryId, 'spirit' AS productType FROM spirits WHERE spirit_id = #{id}
SELECT mixer_id AS id, name, price, category_id AS categoryId, 'mixer' AS productType, mixer_id AS mixerId FROM mixers WHERE mixer_id = #{id}
SELECT fruit_id AS id, name, price, category_id AS categoryId, 'fruit' AS productType, fruit_id AS fruitId FROM fruits WHERE fruit_id = #{id}
SELECT beverage_id AS id, name, price, category_id AS categoryId, 'beverage' AS productType, beverage_id AS beverageId FROM beverages WHERE beverage_id = #{id}
